name: designcraft-bridge
description: Lay out flyers, posters, brochures, menus, cards, certificates and book pages, mail-merge CSV data, edit .designcraft and InDesign .idml documents and export print-ready PDF (PDF/X-4), PNG, IDML, EPUB and HTML, using the DesignCraft publishing app installed on Windows, macOS or Linux. Not affiliated with DesignCraft or Storytold.

designcraft_dir.title: DesignCraft folder
designcraft_dir.description: Install folder of DesignCraft (or DesignCraft.app on macOS). Leave empty to auto-detect: C:\Program Files\DesignCraft, /Applications/DesignCraft.app, /usr/bin, /opt/designcraft or PATH.

designcraft_cli.title: designcraft-cli executable (optional)
designcraft_cli.description: Only if it is somewhere else, e.g. where you unzipped designcraft-cli-<version>-macos-universal.zip on macOS.

control_port.title: DesignCraft control port (optional)
control_port.description: Port used to drive the DesignCraft app (live mode). Default 7981.
